\newcommand{\letterhead}{%

\textcolor{medgray}{\small [Date]}

\vspace{4pt}

\textbf{Re: [Role Title]}\\
[Company], [Location]

\vspace{6pt}

Dear Hiring Manager,

[Hook paragraph: why this specific role is compelling; show genuine understanding of what makes it difficult or interesting. 3-4 sentences.]

[Value paragraph: one concrete story — the judgment call or delivery moment most relevant to this JD. Real outcomes with numbers from brain/person.md. Connect it directly to what the role needs. Never repeat resume bullets verbatim.]

[Confident bridge: connect your domain experience to the role's specific context. No gap language. End with a forward-leaning claim of readiness.]

[Warm close: location, availability, action invite. Max 2 sentences.]

\vspace{4pt}

Warm regards,

\vspace{14pt}

\textbf{[Your Full Name]}\\
{\small\color{medgray}[Phone] \enspace\textbar\enspace
